pass1.notes: Structural overlay — low voice risk, high volume. Keep temperature low.

titles.notes: Title and meta description optimisation. Small payload, Sonnet for quality. ~$0.85 for full run.

pass2.notes: Conversion layer — CTA wording, short outputs. Slightly more creative latitude.

greenfield.notes: Full review generation — voice matters most here. Use the better model.

guide.notes: Three models run in parallel for aggregation. Claude then runs a single editorial pass to improve notes quality before render. If any model fails its results are excluded and the pipeline continues with the others.

aggregators.notes: Primary. Best live web search for entertainment news, release dates, casting.
Real-time web search with citations. Strong at comprehensive research tasks.
Catches prestige, international, and streaming titles. Strong on Google-indexed sources.
Final editorial pass. Reviews and rewrites weak or generic notes fields. Non-fatal — falls back to unedited if it fails.
